backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend API with types and functions for managing products, orders, and contact form submissions, including CRUD operations and data storage using Maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of an admin dashboard navigation link in the Navigation component with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, contexts, and configuration files for the Beat o Beet e-commerce application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes, including kraft paper, burgundy, and forest green brand colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, and admin dashboard, wrapped with QueryClient and CartProvider.
frontend/src/components/CartSidebar.tsx: Sliding sidebar component displaying cart items with quantity controls, remove buttons, total price calculation, and checkout navigation functionality.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with form for submitting customer inquiries (name, email, address, message) to backend via useSubmitContactForm hook, displaying success/error feedback and contact information.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand logo, quick navigation links (products, about, benefits, contact), contact info, copyright notice, and a 'Built with Heart' attribution with app identifier tracking.
frontend/src/components/HealthBenefitsSe: Displays health benefits of beetroot juice in a grid layout with three main benefits (circulation, energy, antioxidants) and a nutritional highlights section listing six key nutrients with their benefits.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image overlay, centered logo, tagline '100% Natural Vitality', product description, and CTA button that scrolls to products section.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile menu, section scroll links (home, products, about, benefits, contact), admin link, and shopping cart button with item count badge that opens CartSidebar.
frontend/src/components/ProcessSection.t: Two-column section explaining the cold press juice production process with three numbered steps (sourcing, cold pressing, purity) alongside a process image and a 'Why Cold Pressed?' highlight box.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, variant, description, benefits list, price, and 'Add to Cart' button with success feedback animation using the cart context.
Displays a grid of four beetroot juice products with details (name, variant, price, benefits) using ProductCard components. Includes a section header and footer note about product qualities (no sugar, preservatives, etc.).
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Provides cart state management via React Context with localStorage persistence. Exports CartProvider and useCart hook for adding, removing, updating quantities, and clearing cart items.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor using React Query, switching between authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication via React Context, managing login/logout state and identity persistence with AuthClient. Exports InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for authentication flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend operations: useSubmitOrder, useOrder, useSubmitContactForm, and useContactSubmissions. Each hook uses the actor from useActor to interact with the ICP canister.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles using Tailwind CSS with custom OKLCH color variables for a kraft paper/beetroot theme. Includes custom font utilities (Caveat script, Inter sans-serif) and brand color classes (burgundy, cream, forest, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin page displaying a sortable table of contact form submissions fetched via useContactSubmissions hook. Includes loading/error states, date formatting, and column sorting functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component with customer information form (name, email, shipping address), cart summary, order submission via useSubmitOrder hook, and navigation to order confirmation page upon success.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that displays order details (ID, customer info, shipping address, status, items, total) after successful checkout, with loading and error states.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (burgundy, brown, cream, kraft, forest) using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a cold-pressed beetroot juice e-commerce website for Mysore Food Labs with features including product showcase, health benefits section, shopping cart, UPI payment, and an admin dashboard with known accessibility issues.
